name: Vigilant Heavy Gunner Mk2 (Bombard rotary repeater, drum pack)
mesh_policy: re-mesh the SDF coarser until under the checker budget; no decimation of print meshes

base.note: 40 mm is new for the line: registered at build time as exosuit.BASES[40] (runtime only, exosuit.py unchanged)

catalog.revision_note: Mk2 heavy gunner: Bombard rotary repeater from the hip, ammunition drum backpack and feed belt; three heavy weapons also as loose bits
catalog.description: Vigilant heavy gunner Mk2 braced behind a six-barrel Bombard rotary repeater fed by a belt from a large ammunition drum backpack; VH2-04 Bastion helm. Loose heavy weapons: VHW-01 Bombard rotary repeater, VHW-02 Carronade rail cannon, VHW-03 Siphon heavy flamer.

images.label: Display sheet: heavy weapons, common scale

buildNotes: Exosuit body (tools/exosuit.py) posed with the Bombard (tools/arsenal3.py VHW-01) integral, both gauntlets closed on its grip and support handle; feed belt integral, butting the drum pack's throat with a 0.1 mm glue gap.
Drum backpack keys on the standard 2.0 mm D-flat pack peg; the figure's back boss is enlarged to 4.6 x 4.8 mm so the socket keeps a 1.2 mm wall.
Figure meshed at spec voxel_mm, loose weapons at bit_voxel_mm, re-meshed coarser only if over budget (reports/build.json).
catalog.limitations: Procedural design; printability is a heuristic screen. No STEP export (FreeCAD not installed on the build host).
